title: Repeat Small Spend by Merchant
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| stats count as purchases, sum(amount) as spend, avg(amount) as avg_ticket by merchant
| where purchases>=5
| sort - spend
description: Surfaces the merchants where tiny repeat purchases have become a pattern.
value: The real leak is often not one expensive impulse but the place you visit a little too often without noticing.
implementation: Track merchant names for micro-spend transactions; rank merchants by repeat-purchase count and total spend.
visualization: Merchant leaderboard of repeat small spend.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which places you keep making lots of little purchases from, even if each one feels harmless on its own.
